mapper.insert: INSERT INTO circle (creator_id, name, description, cover, tags, member_count, post_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{creatorId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{tags}, #{memberCount}, #{postCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM circle
AND tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY member_count DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT c.* FROM circle c INNER JOIN circle_member cm ON c.id = cm.circle_id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 1 ORDER BY cm.join_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE circle SET member_count = #{count}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE circle SET post_count = #{count}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
